title: Back to the Future: The Game

info.about: Back to the Future: The Game is an episodic graphic adventure video game based on the Back to the Future film franchise. The game was developed and published by Telltale Games as part of a licensing deal with Universal Pictures.
info.trivia: Kid Beyond voiced Biff Tannen in this original release; Tom Wilson only returned to the role for the 2015 re-release.
info.why: It was delisted from all digital storefronts by the end of 2018 following the closure of Telltale Games.
